items.title: U.S. economy unexpectedly lost 23,000 jobs in July
items.description: Nonfarm payrolls were projected to increase by 83,000 in July while the unemployment rate held steady at 4.2%, according to the Dow Jones consensus.

items.title: Companies scoff at airlines' cheapest business class tickets. 'The real value is flexibility'
items.description: Some companies plan to shun the cheapest business- and premium- economy fares from their executives.

items.title: Volkswagen controlling families call for faster overhaul to fend off Chinese rivals
items.description: Volkswagen's top investor on Friday called on the auto giant to take immediate action to fend off intensifying competition from Chinese car brands.

items.title: K-shaped economy shows up in housing: Luxury sales rise as starter-home buyers struggle
items.description: Even as luxury homes fly off the market, sales of starter homes are down despite growing inventory and more price cuts, research shows.

items.title: Solar stocks shine after Trump extends China tariffs to polysilicon products
items.description: Solar stocks rose in premarket trading President Donald Trump announced fresh import restrictions on polysilicon products.

items.title: China is gaining ground in AI. But the U.S. still has a major advantage
items.description: Chinese AI companies have made recent leaps in closing the performance gap with U.S. frontier labs.

items.title: Martha's Vineyard African American Film Festival set for record attendance despite macro challenges
items.description: MVAAFF founder Floyd Rance says the festival has found a sustainable audience on the Massachusetts island, helping it weather macroeconomic uncertainty.

items.title: Wildfire costs are surging — but much of the damage in Europe isn’t insured
items.description: Insurers warn that Europe is facing a "protection gap" in wildfire cover as disaster recovery costs outpace insurance coverage.

items.title: Yen rally fades a week after U.S.-Japan intervention as focus shifts to policy
items.description: The coordinated involvement from the Treasury and BoJ had initially lifted the yen as low as 155 to the dollar, down from just above 163 beforehand.

items.title: SK Hynix to invest $38 billion building new memory chip plants as demand soars
items.description: Memory prices have surged because of short supply and huge demand with investors watching closely for any changes to the supply-demand imbalance.

items.title: China's exports growth beats estimates in July, as AI-driven shipments surge
items.description: China's exports rose more than expected in July, as global demand for high-tech components continues to absorb the country's manufactured goods.

items.title: Iran's chief negotiator accuses Trump of 'theater diplomacy' with Hormuz traffic near standstill
items.description: The conflict is broadening across the region, with Gulf energy infrastructure and key shipping chokepoints under renewed threat.

items.title: Meta ordered to pay $567 million into abatement fund as remedy to child harms case in New Mexico
items.description: A judge in New Mexico ordered Meta to pay $567 million into an abatement fund after a jury ruled the company violated the state’s unfair practices act.

items.title: From birth to brokerage: Why South Korea is seeing a surge in infant investment accounts
items.description: South Korean babies are turning into mini shareholders, thanks to their parents' investment strategies.

items.title: Grindr's AI spend is paying off and its pricey new tier has had some surprises, CEO says
items.description: Grindr says AI is boosting engineering productivity, supporting a new $350-per-month premium tier and driving stronger subscriber growth and retention.

items.title: Jim Cramer highlights 5 investing themes — and the stocks to buy for each
items.description: CNBC’s Jim Cramer said earnings season reinforced five investing themes he thinks will produce the market's best buying opportunities.

items.title: GAO finds Elon Musk's DOGE inflated claims of $110 billion in savings for federal government
items.description: The nonpartisan watchdog found Elon Musk's DOGE didn't cut as much federal spending as it claimed and that it fell far short of its promised $2 trillion.

items.title: Airbnb stock soars 9% on earnings and revenue beat, strong guidance for third quarter
items.description: Airbnb said it's seeing strong demand "across all regions," contributing to the company's better-than-expected forecast.

items.title: AMD buys chip startup that hardwires AI models into its silicon
items.description: Taalas' current chip runs a small version of Meta's Llama 3.1, though the company is working on chips for bigger and more advanced models.

items.title: Sweetgreen cuts full-year outlook as cyclospora fears weigh on sales
items.description: The salad chain has not been implicated in the ongoing cyclospora outbreak.
